    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    if w % 2 == 1 and all(row[w // 2] == grid[0][w // 2] for row in grid):

        a = grid[:k]

    else:

    shared = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
    common = max(shared, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in a + b for x in row))
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else common for c in range(len(a[0]))] for r in range(len(a))]
